popular.label: Wall-Mounted Mail Organizer
popular.blurb: Open-front horizontal slots hold letters and flat mail

popular.label: Water Wheel
popular.blurb: Two exterior plywood rims, each with a hub in its open centre between two crossed spokes, one on each face of the rim

popular.label: Under-stairs shelves
popular.blurb: Uprights step down with the stair slope; scribe each top to the stringer.

fresh.label: Laptop Stand
fresh.blurb: Elevates laptop for ergonomics and underside airflow

fresh.label: Utility cart
fresh.blurb: Three plywood shelves on four 2×2 corner posts, rolling on four 2" locking swivel casters (3" of the height).

fresh.label: Jewelry box
fresh.blurb: A small hinged box: a ring row along the front and two compartments behind it; line the floor with felt.

fresh.label: Bird feeder
fresh.blurb: A hopper feeder: seed sits in the hopper between two clear panes and spills out of a 1/2" gap at the bottom onto the tray.

fresh.label: Raised garden bed
fresh.blurb: No bottom: the bed sits right on the ground so roots go down and water drains.

fresh.label: Outdoor storage bench
fresh.blurb: A seat you can sit on outside with a dry box under it: the lid lifts on two hinges and a lid stay holds it open.

fresh.label: Guitar hanger
fresh.blurb: The guitar hangs by its headstock: the neck drops between the two yoke prongs and the headstock rests on them.

fresh.label: Standing desk converter
fresh.blurb: Sits on the desk you have: a raised monitor shelf at the back and a lower keyboard shelf in front, so you stand to type with your elbows at 90°.
